Gale Wings Quirk.name: Gale Wings Quirk
Gale Wings Quirk.description:
🪽 Your feathered wings make their own wind, so you fly with less flapping.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Wings and Wind: smaller wings and about half a single Quirk's gust range, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you hop onto low roofs on an air pocket and shove foes back with a wing gust.
📈 With training: glides over a block, air-edged feathers, hovering rescues while a feather-gust sweeps people clear, a wind dome that shelters a group under your wings, and a diving gale strike.
⚠️ Wet or damaged feathers ground you, and strong crosswinds still win.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as making wind while aloft burns breath fast.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hawks (Fierce Wings), Inasa Yoarashi (Whirlwind).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Control +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Tailwind Takeoff, Pinion Push
Gale Wings Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: user-height feathered wings stream currents from the quills for low-flap flight and hovering; at first a one-story roof, a narrow street in one gliding beat, a gust shoving an adult about five meters. More needs learned techniques. Limits: wet, muddied or damaged feathers ground them at once, shedding too many until regrown; strong crosswinds overpower them; indoors no diving speed. Quirk Strain: wings cost nothing; light: hop, gust; moderate: glide survey, edged feather, hover rescue; heavy: plumes, underwing dome; severe: signature dive strike, thermal corridor. Fusion: Wings and Wind at about half single-nature range and force; no wide feather telekinesis, thrown gales or free cyclones; only it hovers still on wing-wind, sweeps people clear, domes air underwing, dives in a gale. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: wings are legal; unlicensed public flight or gusts are unlawful Quirk use, diving strikes assault. Look: wings in the player's chosen color.
